title: Hospital network operations
brief: Our hospital network wants to coordinate operating theatres, beds and shared equipment such as MRI scanners across three sites. When equipment fails or a theatre overruns, schedulers must find another slot or another site and tell the teams. The system must never decide diagnosis or treatment: clinical decisions stay with clinicians. Moving a booked procedure to another site needs the agreement of the responsible clinician. Equipment maintenance has priority over bookings, but urgent procedures always have priority over everything.
